verdict.rationale: Snowflake provides native streaming/incremental transformation primitives — Streams for CDC (snowflake-docs-7), Snowpipe for continuous micro-batch ingestion (snowflake-docs-6), Dynamic Tables (declarative pipelines, GA per snowflake-docs-15), and Tasks orchestration referenced via dbt Projects on Snowflake pipeline orchestration (snowflake-docs-2/55/61). These map directly to streams, tasks, and declarative pipelines as described in the story. Missing for 10: no first-party benchmark or independent hands-on validation of continuous query latency/throughput at scale, and no explicit doc citation for the 'Tasks' object itself beyond dynamic tables/dbt orchestration.
